Description: Unique identifier for each daily inventory record (e.g. INV000001).
Calendar date of the inventory record. Spans one year (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31).
Type of business: Restaurant, Supermarket, Cafeteria, Cloud Kitchen.
Food category tracked: Fruits, Vegetables, Dairy, Bakery, Meat, Prepared Food.
Total units purchased/stocked for the day (units).
Total units sold during the day (units). Always <= Purchase_Quantity.
Number of days before the batch expires, depends on Food_Category.
Storage temperature in degrees Celsius, depends on Food_Category.
Estimated/realized customer demand for the day (units), affected by Business_Type, Weather, Promotion.
Whether a promotion/discount was running that day.
Weather condition: Sunny, Rainy, Cloudy, Hot.
Units wasted from Remaining_Stock. Always <= Remaining_Stock.
Dominant cause of waste: Expired, Overproduction, Low Demand, Storage Issue, or No Waste (no waste occurred).
Whether wasted-but-still-safe food was donated instead of discarded.
Overall waste severity for the record: Low, Medium, High. Derived from the waste-to-purchase ratio.
